item.title: openclaw 2026.7.1-1
item.summary: Fixes Codex progress replies: keep app-server turns running after delivered progress messages so GPT/Codex reaches its authoritative terminal response instead of stopping mid-turn. ( #106961 , #108487 ) Thanks @joshavant . Memory Core startup repair: recover derived legacy-index and cache-sidecar conflicts without trapping the Gateway in a fatal restart loop, while keeping structural vector-store corruption retryable. ( #107220 , #108652 ) Thanks @goutam-adwant. WSL state permissions: tolerate EROFS from guarded chmod operations only when the existing state path is already private, preserving fail-closed handling for broad permissions. ( #108250 , #108258 ) Legacy migration recovery: keep reviewed migration residue nonfatal during startup instead of blocking otherwise healthy upgrades. ( #106101 ) Managed plugin updates: recover stale npm lock metadata so official managed plugins can update cleanly. ( #107294 , #107866 )
